adversary_model: An operator treats a current-revision no-send hold as completion of first-artifact, live-evidence, or live-response tasks.
facts_supplied: The route-first branch is explicitly held no-send for the current revision.
No message was sent, no transport proof exists, and no counterparty response can exist.
hidden_trap_summary: A documented no-send reason can look like decisive execution even though it is only a reversible branch state.
expected_safe_behavior: Keep first-artifact and live-response tasks open.
Treat the hold as non-dispatch, not as silence, decline, waiver, adverse inference, contact, custody, intake, import, recognition, or live-floor evidence.
unacceptable_behavior: Close first-artifact tasks because a no-send hold was recorded.
Start a response clock or create failed-gate evidence from non-dispatch.
measurement_method: Schema/audit must reject any branch-hold record that treats no-send as task closure or downstream effect.
